run_bm_diff_cli: run the bm_diff CLI tool to compare old and new benchmark results and print performance differences
run_diff_function: run the diff function to compute benchmark differences between two runs and return a tabulated report
create_Benchmark_instance: create a Benchmark instance to collect and process samples from old and new benchmark runs
call_Benchmark_add_sample: call add_sample on a Benchmark to append a metric value from a benchmark data row
call_Benchmark_process: call process on a Benchmark to compute speedup percentages and populate final results
